# 75TechStore
> Lagos-based tech company selling brand new & UK-used iPhones, laptops, desktops, and accessories. Also provides software development, laptop repairs, and IT consulting. Founded 2020. RC: 8681711.

## Company Information
- **Legal Name**: Seven Five Techstore Limited
- **Trading Name**: 75TechStore
- **Founded**: 2020
- **Founder**: Kenneth Osazuwa (Software Engineer)
- **RC Number**: 8681711 (Corporate Affairs Commission, Nigeria)
- **Website**: https://www.75techstore.com.ng
- **Phone**: +234-706-645-9689
- **Instagram**: @75techstore
- **Profile**: https://techbehemoths.com/company/75techstore

## Physical Location
- **Address**: M Plaza, Adepele Street, Computer Village, Ikeja, Lagos, Nigeria
- **Business Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM (Closed Sundays)
- **Area**: Computer Village, Ikeja — West Africa's largest technology market

## Business Model
75TechStore operates as a dual-facing brand:
1. **B2C Retail**: Sales of brand new and UK-used premium electronics to consumers across Nigeria
2. **B2B Digital Services**: Software development, web applications, mobile apps, and IT consulting for startups and corporate organizations

## Products We Sell
- **Smartphones**: iPhone (all models), Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, Xiaomi, Tecno, Infinix — brand new and UK-used
- **Laptops**: MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, Dell XPS, HP EliteBook, Lenovo ThinkPad, ASUS ROG gaming laptops
- **Desktops**: Custom-built PCs, iMacs, all-in-one desktops
- **Gaming**: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, gaming accessories
- **Audio**: AirPods, Sony WH-1000XM series, JBL speakers, Bose, Beats
- **Wearables**: Apple Watch, Samsung Galaxy Watch, fitness trackers
- **Tablets**: iPad Pro, iPad Air, Samsung Galaxy Tab, Microsoft Surface
- **Accessories**: Chargers, cables, cases, screen protectors, power banks, docking stations

## Services We Offer
- **Software Development**: Custom websites, web applications, e-commerce stores, and mobile applications using React.js and modern frameworks
- **Website Development**: Responsive, secure, high-performance websites optimized for SEO and speed
- **Mobile App Development**: iOS and Android applications
- **Laptop & Gadget Repair**: Professional repair services for laptops, phones, and tablets by certified engineers
- **IT Consulting**: Digital transformation and tech integration for startups and corporate organizations
- **E-commerce Solutions**: Custom online store development with payment integration
